Introducing Friendzone: Build the Place Your Friends Keep Coming
 Back To
77647.body:
What's Happening in DCL

Автор: Decentraland


Автор: Decentraland

    
    
    Прочитайте цю статтю на LinkedIn, щоб приєднатися до обговорення
Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/introducing-friendzone-build-place-your-friends-keep-coming-mug3e?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3BX0bx9H7cTUSdP9Qbc310Dg%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=1Ifd7IAX2iuso1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~msyu4dhc~xo-null-null&eid=fz96fz-msyu4dhc-xo
  
Introducing Friendzone, the next DCL Regenesis Labs Buildathon. Registration is now open. From August 14 to September 4, creators will have three weeks to build their own social experience in a Decentraland World and compete for a share of an $8,000 MANA prize pool, plus additional rewards, badges and potential featuring in the Decentraland Mobile App. But Friendzone is about more than prizes. Every community should have that place... ...where you meet after a long day. Where someone always shows up. Where a five-minute visit somehow turns into an hour. Where friendships form, inside jokes begin and familiar faces keep coming back. And that place doesn’t have to be tied to a physical location anymore. These spaces can exist online. Digital, persistent and accessible anytime, from anywhere. The future is now. And in @decentraland, that place can be anything you imagine. A game. A chaotic party room. A cooperative challenge. A competitive arena. A strange little corner of the internet that only makes sense to you and your friends. With Friendzone, we want to empower creators to explore the possibilities of Decentraland Worlds and build more of those places that bring people together at a time when feeling connected in the physical world isn’t always easy. Your people. Your idea. Your Friendzone. What does your Friendzone look like? There is no single answer 🤷‍♀️ Friendzone is about exploring what social experiences in Decentraland can be: Build a hangout where the environment gives people a reason to connect Create a game that gets better when friends join Design a challenge people want to replay together Make something weird, funny, competitive, cooperative, cozy or chaotic. What matters is that your experience gives people a reason to spend time together, invite friends and come back. And here comes the challenge: we want these experiences to be optimized for the Decentraland Mobile App. Because your favorite place does not have to stay behind when you leave your computer. Your Friendzone can be with you wherever you go. Open your phone. Jump in. See who’s around. Hang out. That’s the idea we want Friendzone creators to explore. The timeline August 14: Friendzone Kickoff and Build Phase begins August 14 to September 4: Three-week Build Phase September 4: Submission Deadline September 5 to 11: Judging September 13: Winner Reveal
